details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5745-5747, 7630-7633 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `_load_actions_runs_cached` and `date +%s` fallback paths suppress errors and can make the inflight guard fail open.
  WHY: If either helper fails, the guard emits empty values and the legacy empty-commit path can proceed; the reviewer notes this is documented defense-in-depth rather than a new regression.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5769-5779 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The managed `retrigger_review` inflight check sets `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` but does not return early.
  WHY: The reviewer says later logic can still execute after the guard has already detected an inflight run.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7587-7667 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The standalone `retrigger_review` inflight check sets `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` but does not return early.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree on whether the later `elif` gating makes this harmless, but they all point to the same control-flow asymmetry versus the managed path and the reviewed code continues past the guard.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5791-5799, 7636-7641 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: There is still a cache-snapshot-to-push TOCTOU window around the inflight guard.
  WHY: The reviewer says the remote-head recheck closes only a narrower sub-race, while the broader window remains documented defense-in-depth.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5740-5754 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `retrigger_review` jq matcher is reported as using `_rtr_head_sha` without a local declaration.
  WHY: One reviewer says the variable is already declared and initialized earlier, while another says it is missing, so the concern is whether the inflight-dispatch matcher can miss blank `head_branch` runs.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5729-5732 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The comment block uses hardcoded line-number references that will drift.
  WHY: The reviewer says future maintainers will be sent to stale locations as files change.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5784-5807 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: A transient `git checkout` failure in the managed retrigger path can leave the worktree attached to `origin/${head_ref}`.
  WHY: Reviewers say `git checkout --detach HEAD` only runs on the successful branch, so the worktree can be left in an unexpected state; one reviewer also notes the final guard only protects the counter increment.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5751-5756, 7643-7650 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The reviewer believes the jq inflight matcher's `endswith(...)` predicates are invalid and can cause the guard to fail.
  WHY: In that reading, `_inflight_id` stays empty and the empty-commit push proceeds.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5725-5742, 7592-7609 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The workflow-run matcher is duplicated in both managed and standalone paths.
  WHY: Reviewers warn that changes to workflow names, fallback logic, or cutoff semantics must be mirrored in both places or one side will silently diverge.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1558-1584 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The `/actions/runs` mock's `save()`/`jq` ordering can leave request bookkeeping stale or half-updated when `jq` fails.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree on the exact placement of `save()`, but all say the failing `jq` path can bypass persistence and corrupt later assertions.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5712-5775, 7592-7664 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The inflight guard performs cache loading, date parsing, and a jq scan on every stall-recovery tick.
  WHY: The reviewer says this adds measurable CPU/JQ overhead in the poller loop even though it avoids extra API calls.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7587-7667 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The standalone `retrigger_review` inflight check sets `STALL_RECOVERY_EFFECTIVE_ACTION` but does not return early.
  WHY: The reviewer says the later flag gating still prevents counter consumption, so they treat this as a structural asymmetry rather than a runtime bug.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5740-5754 | severity=low | confidence=1
  PROBLEM: The review says `_rtr_head_sha` is used in the jq filter without being declared local.
  WHY: The reviewer also says this claim is incorrect because `_rtr_head_sha` is declared and initialized earlier, so they conclude there is no runtime failure.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5791-5799, 7636-7641 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: There is still a cache-snapshot-to-push TOCTOU window around the inflight guard.
  WHY: The reviewer says the remote-head recheck closes only a narrower sub-race, while the broader window remains documented defense-in-depth.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:7625-7628 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The standalone path uses `elif` after detecting an in-flight review run instead of returning early.
  WHY: The reviewer says this defeats the guard because execution continues into the later git-fetch branch instead of stopping at the inflight detection.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5799-5807 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: If `git checkout "origin/${head_ref}"` fails, the cleanup step `git checkout --detach HEAD` never runs.
  WHY: The reviewer says the worktree can remain attached to `origin/${head_ref}`, which is a minor state-management issue even though the recovery counter still is not incremented.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM mistralai_mistral-small-2603 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5769-5779, 7640-7650 | severity=high | confidence=5

  WHY: The reviewer says this can let later fallback logic continue after the guard has already identified an inflight run.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5751-5756, 7643-7650 | severity=high | confidence=5

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5784-5799 | severity=medium | confidence=4

  WHY: The reviewer says the detached checkout only runs after a successful checkout, so the worktree can be left in an unexpected state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5790-5795, 7665-7670 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The push-success gating only protects `STALL_RECOVERY_SHOULD_INCREMENT`, so non-push failures can still let partial git-side effects happen before the function returns 1.
  WHY: The reviewer says this can mask the true execution state and preserve stale-state issues.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:1558-1584 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `/actions/runs` mock does not reliably persist bookkeeping around the nested `jq` path.
  WHY: The reviewer says a failing `jq` subprocess can exit before `save()`, leaving request-count/status state stale.
